_doc: Hollow Howler voice per event (concept KONZEPT-HOLLOW-HOWLER-GRUSEL-2026-10-15.md section 10). mode: synth = variant A everywhere (committed synthesis), vanilla = variant B everywhere (built from Vanilla at build time), mix = per event as in 'mix', eleven = 'mix' plus the ElevenLabs takes of the events in 'eleven' (W24-3 owner 23.10., default; committed in modules/simplemobs/shared/howler-eleven, made by tools/sounds/eleven_howler_takes.py from the named candidate). -PsbHowlerSounds / SB_HOWLER_SOUNDS override mode for one build.
